# Good Jobs

> Good Jobs is a self-hosted job search aggregator for Vietnam and global/remote roles. One search streams recent listings from 21 job boards — LinkedIn, ITviec, TopCV, VietnamWorks, CareerViet, CareerLink, TopDev, JobsGo, Glints, ViecOi, Indeed VN, TechJobs, Xóm Jobs, Google Careers, Indeed, RemoteOK, We Work Remotely, Glassdoor, USAJOBS and Dice — with AI keyword detection, skill extraction and match scores. Every listing links back to the original posting.

## Pages
- [Home / search](https://goodjobs.io.vn/): search by job title, skills or CV and location. English by default, with an EN/VI toggle in the header (client-side, same URL).
- [Post a job](https://goodjobs.io.vn/post-job/): submit a job for review.
- [Contact](https://goodjobs.io.vn/contact/): support, partnerships and privacy requests.
- [Privacy policy](https://goodjobs.io.vn/privacy/)
- [Terms of service](https://goodjobs.io.vn/terms/)

## Vietnam job boards
LinkedIn, ITViec, TopCV, VietnamWorks, CareerViet, CareerLink, TopDev, JobsGo, Glints, ViecOi, Indeed VN, TechJobs, Xóm Jobs, Google Careers.

## Global / remote boards
LinkedIn, Indeed, RemoteOK, We Work Remotely, Glassdoor, USAJOBS, Dice.
